# Wheel of Heaven API

> The static JSON API for the Wheel of Heaven project — every curated
> page on www.wheelofheaven.world has a deterministic JSON twin here,
> plus surfaces (bibliography, glossary, translation provenance,
> schemas, controlled vocabularies) that are only exposed via the API.
> No auth, no rate limits, CC0-1.0 public domain.

## Discovery

- [Manifest](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/): every endpoint with cross-links.
- [JSON Schemas](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/schema/): one per kind (draft 2020-12). Validate responses against these.
- [Enums](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/enums/): controlled vocabularies — authority tier, source family, claim type, etc.
- [Sitemap](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/sitemap.xml): every endpoint URL.
- [Content graph](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/graph/): the typed relatedness graph (nodes + `see_also`/`in_body` edges) over the corpus, with an orphan / asymmetric-`see_also` QA block. Per-node ego-networks at `/v1/graph/{section}/{slug}/` for cheap AI traversal.

## For AI agents

These endpoints are curated narrative summaries, designed for direct system-prompt ingestion:

- [Project context](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/context/): overview, sections, sub-context map.
- [Working hypothesis](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/context/hypothesis/): the project's main claim, stated as prose with claim-type labels.
- [Key terminology](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/context/terminology/): canonical naming choices when discussing the project (Elohim, Yahweh, Raëlism, World Age, etc.) including a do-not-use table.
- [Precessional ages](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/context/timeline/): the 12 ages with start/end years.
- [Source program](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/context/sources/): the six-tier authority model + source-family taxonomy.
- [Editorial method](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/context/method/): claim types (direct / inferred / speculative), the six-source rule, editorial passes, translation policy.

## Content surfaces

Every page has a JSON twin:

- [Wiki](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/wiki/): ~111 encyclopedia entries. Drill into `/v1/wiki/{slug}/` for body + extras.
- [Timeline](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/timeline/): 12 precessional ages + 3 framing pages. `/v1/timeline/{slug}/` for the long-form body.
- [Articles](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/articles/): long-form essays.
- [News](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/news/): Newsroom dispatches (current events read through the canon).
- [Library books](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/library/books/): 100+ primary and comparative texts with chapter/verse JSON.
- [Tradition hubs](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/sources/traditions/): per-tradition landing pages explaining why the tradition is included and where it converges / diverges from the canon.
- [Sources / bibliography](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/sources/): 67 source records with authority tier, family, stance, licensing.
- [Glossary](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/glossary/): multilingual terminology.
- [Translations](https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/translations/): WoH Translation provenance (the `-woh` book family).

## Multilingual

Same surface under `/v1/{lang}/...` for: en (default), de, fr, es, ru, ja, zh, zh-Hant, ko.

## Citing

Wheel of Heaven content is CC0-1.0 public domain. Attribution is appreciated but not required.

Suggested citation:
> Zinsfuss, Zara. *Wheel of Heaven API*. api.wheelofheaven.world. Accessed [date].

For specific endpoints, append path:
> Zinsfuss, Zara. "Elohim." *Wheel of Heaven API*. https://api.wheelofheaven.world/v1/wiki/elohim/. Accessed [date].

## Documentation

- [AI & LLM Ingestion guide (docs site)](https://docs.wheelofheaven.world/ai-ingestion/): canonical reference for using the corpus with AI systems — quickstart, llms.txt + llms-full.txt, the API surface for agents, the curated `/v1/context/*` endpoints, library + bibliography extraction, RAG patterns, system-prompt templates, and attribution.
- [API Reference (docs site)](https://docs.wheelofheaven.world/reference/api/): endpoint catalogue, envelope spec, enum + schema reference.
- [Architecture overview (docs site)](https://docs.wheelofheaven.world/architecture/sites/api/): design principles, build pipeline, data sources.
- [Source code (GitHub)](https://github.com/wheelofheaven/api.wheelofheaven.world).

## Reading site

- [www.wheelofheaven.world](https://www.wheelofheaven.world): the human-readable counterpart.
- [www llms.txt](https://www.wheelofheaven.world/llms.txt): manifest for the reading site.
- [www llms-full.txt](https://www.wheelofheaven.world/llms-full.txt): full-corpus AI ingestion file.
